stories.title: Joined six months into a live program with no repo, toolchain, CI/CD, or release process; built all of it and hit SOP on schedule
Owned the task scheduler; rebalanced function calls across periodic rates; the 'bugs' were scheduling conflicts
60 repos of hand-edited linker files became a YAML source of truth with Python generators and Conan deploy; retired a full-time manual role
Germany consolidated integration control, NA got cut, the OEM killed 3.0; pivoted to an architect role through the architecture lead
At 12, ran a 250K-member community with Python and Lua and monetization; the tell-me-about-yourself opener
Accept, negotiate, or decline authority over every OEM line item; the OEM-facing repo mirror; fleet data pipeline for future autonomy
Knew the profiles and limits of ~140 engineers and pre-empted where balls would drop
NA product owner of software integration on the largest ADAS program, follow-the-sun with Germany, on a centralized ADAS compute platform
